ZCLAIM is a trustless cross-chain asset transfer protocol. ZCLAIM uses collateralized issuers to back tokenized Bitcoin on other blockchains. ZCLAIM verifies Bitcoin transactions with SPV proofs rather than relying on a custodian.

Ronin bridge is a bridge between the Ethereum blockchain and the Ronin sidechain. Ronin bridge relies on a set of validators that hold custody of the bridged assets. Ronin bridge uses a multisignature threshold scheme controlled by its validators, which makes it a federated, custodial design. Ronin bridge was the target of a large exploit in March 2022.

Stargate Finance is a cross-chain liquidity transport protocol. Stargate Finance is built on top of LayerZero for cross-chain messaging. Stargate Finance pools liquidity on multiple blockchains to enable asset transfers between them.

LayerZero is an omnichain interoperability protocol for cross-chain messaging. LayerZero uses an independent oracle and an independent relayer to verify messages between chains. LayerZero is permissionless, so applications can deploy on it without an intermediary operator.

Xclaim is a framework for trustless, cryptocurrency-backed assets. Xclaim uses collateralized vault issuers to back assets issued on other blockchains. Xclaim verifies backing transactions with SPV proofs rather than relying on a trusted custodian.
